highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.151.4 corrects the Windows HarfBuzz disabled-warnings BinSkim error.

bullets.detail: Windows HarfBuzz native assets no longer trigger BinSkim BA2007 for disabled compiler warnings. Exported symbols and shaping behavior are unchanged.
